simple.meaning: to fasten upon; hence, to seize , be strong (figuratively, courageous , causatively strengthen , cure , help , repair , fortify ), obstinate ; to bind , restrain , conquer
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חָזַק (H2388) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 290 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: חָזַק (châzaq) means to fasten upon; hence, to seize , be strong (figuratively, courageous , causatively strengthen , cure , help , repair , fortify ), obstinate ; to bind , restrain , conquer First listed occurrence: 1Chr 11 10.

definitions.full: H2388. chazaq חָזַק 291 verb be or grow firm, strong, strengthen (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic חֲזַק bind on or about, gird on , compare Arabic bind, squeeze ) — Qal Perfect ׳ח Gen 41:57 4 t.; חָזָק֑ 2Chr 26:15 ; suffix חֲזָקוֺ 28:20 , etc.; Imperfect יֶהֱז֑ק 28:7 (Baer) + 2 t.; וַיֶּחֱזַק Gen 41:56 +; יֶחֶזְקוּ 2Sam 10:11 2 t.; יֶחְזְקוּ Isa 28:22 ; Imperative חֲזַק Deut 12:23 +; חִזְקוּ 31:6 +; Infinitive construct לְחָזְקָה 2Kin 12:13 ; suffix לְחָזְקָהּ Ezek 30:21 ; Participle חָזֵק Exod 19:19 ; 2Sam 3:1 , etc.; — I. intransitive be or grow strong: — 1. a. of physical strength of hands Judg 7:11 ; 2Sam 2:7 ; 16:21 ; Ezek 22:14 ; Zech 8:9 , 13 (on Ezek 3:14 see below); of arm, followed by infinitive 30:21 ; used of recovery from illness Isa 39:1 ; followed by מִן of comparison over power 1Sam 17:50 (with בְּ instrumental), 2Sam 13:14 . b. of people, army Deut 11:8 ; Josh 17:13 (JE), = Judg 1:28 ; Ezra 9:12 ; followed by מִן comparative be stronger than, too strong for, prevail against 2Sam 10:11 (twice in verse) = 1Chr 19:12 (twice in verse); 1Kin 20:23 , 25 ; id. , followed by accusative 16:22 , compare of ׳י as prevailing over man Jer 20:7 (|| יָכֹל ); followed by על 2Chr 8:3 ; 27:5 . c. of royal power וְהָזֵק הֹלֵךְ וְדָוִד 2Sam 3:1 (opposed to וְדַלִּים הֹלְכִים ); compare 2Chr 26:15 (|| חֶזְקָה 26:16 ), Dan 11:5 a. d. prevail over, upon , of word of king 2Sam 24:4 (followed by אֶלֿ ) = 1Chr 21:4 (followed by עַל ). e. of bonds Isa 28:22 . f. of sound of trumpet מְאֹד וְהָזֵק הוֺלֵךְ Exod 19:19 (E, compare חָזָק 19:16 ) it grew much louder and louder. 2 be firm, fast: — a. literally be caught fast , of Absalom's head 2Sam 18:9 (followed by בְּ ). b. be firm, secure , of a kingdom 2Kin 14:5 ( + בְּיָדוֺ ) = 2Chr 25:3 ( + עָלָיו ). Oftener c. be firm = courageous, confident, especially Imperative, usually || אמץ (q. v.), Deut 31:6-7 , 23 ; Josh 1:6-7 , 9 , 18 ; 10:25 ; 23:6 (all D), 2Sam 10:12 ; 13:28 ; 1Kin 2:2 ; 1Chr 19:13 (|| התחזק ), 22:13 ; 28:10 , 20 ; 2Chr 15:7 ; 19:11 ; 32:7 ; Ezra 10:4 ; Psa 27:14 ; Psalm 31:25; Isa 35:4 ; 41:6 ; Hag 2:4 (3 t. in verse); Dan 10:19 (twice in verse); followed by לַמִּלְחָמָה 2Chr 25:8 . d. hold firmly to, devote oneself to , followed by בְּ 2Chr 31:4 . e. followed by Infinitive be firm not to eat blood, i.e. firmly refrain from it Deut 12:23 , compare 1Chr 28:7 . 3 press, be urgent , followed by עַל + Infinitive Exod 12:33 (E); followed by עַל of hand of ׳י in prophetic ecstasy Ezek 3:14 ( ᵐ5 Co read חֲזָקָה , adjective, see חָזָק ). 4 in bad sense : a. grow stout, rigid, hard , with idea of perversity, of Pharaoh's heart Exod 7:13 , 22 ; 8:15 (all P), 9:35 (R); compare דבריכם עָלַי חזקו Mal 3:13 . b. be severe, grievous , of battle 2Kin 3:26 ; of famine Gen 41:56-57 , (E), 47:20 (J; followed by על ), 2Kin 25:3 = Jer 52:6 . II. transitive only חֲזֶקוֺ לֹא 2Chr 28:20 strengthened him not , but text very dubious (|| לוֺ וַיָצַר ). Pi`el Perfect חִזַּק Psa 147:13 +, etc.; Imperfect וַיְחַזֵּק Exod 9:12 10 t., etc.; Imperative חַזֵּק Neh 6:9 2 t.; feminine singular חַזְּקִי Nahum 3:14 ; חַזֵּ֑קִי Isa 54:2 etc.; Infinitive construct חַזֵּק 2Kin 12:9 12 t.; Participle מְחַזֵּק Exod 14:17 ; מְחַזְּקִים 2Kin 12:9 ; — 1 make strong (physically): a. followed by accusative of person Judg 16:28 ; followed by על 3:12 ; followed by מָתְנַיִם Nahum 2:2 (|| כֹּחַ אַמֵּץ ; of personified people). b. = restore to strength Dan 10:18-19 , to health Ezek 34:4 , 16 ; with לְ give strength to 1Chr 29:12 ; so, followed by זְרוֺעֹתָם , Hosea 7:15 ; Ezek 30:24 (and 30:25 Co, see Hiph`il ) c. followed by accusative of thing Isa 41:7 ; Jer 10:4 (both with בְּ instrumental; of manufacture of idols); of strengthening tent-pegs, in metaphor Isa 54:4 , compare 33:23 ; followed by bars of gates Psa 147:13 ; often of making strong, fortifying a town, etc. Nahum 3:14 ; 2Chr 11:11-12 , 26:9 ; 32:5 ; = repair (wall, object not expressed) Neh 3:19 see Hiph`il; with accusative of temple 2Kin 12:6 ; 12:7 ; 12:15 ; 22:6 ; 2Chr 24:5 , 12 ; 29:3 ; 34:8 , compare 34:10 (|| לִבְדּוֺק ); followed by י ׳לְבית 1Chr 26:27 ; object breaches (accusative) 2Kin 12:8 ; 12:9 ; 12:13 ; 22:5 . d. of establishing kingdom 2Chr 11:17 . 2 strengthen the hands (accusative) of any one, i.e. sustain, encourage (opposed to רִמָּה ) Judg 9:24 ; Jer 23:14 ; Ezek 13:22 ; Isa 35:3 ; Job 4:3 ; Ezra 6:22 ; Neh 2:18 ; 6:9 ; 2Chr 29:34 ; ׳וַיְח בֵּאלהים ידו 1Sam 23:16 ; followed by בְּ Ezra 1:6 ( + בְּ instrumental) 3 make strong = bold, encourage , with accusative Deut 1:38 ; 3:28 ; 2Sam 11:5 ; Isa 41:7 ; with accusative of person + י בֵּית ׳לַעֲבֹדַת 2Chr 35:2 . 4 make firm: — a. with 2 accusative אֲחַוְּקֶנּוּ וְאַבְנֵטְךָ Isa 22:21 and with thy sash (of office) will I make him firm , i.e. bind it firmly about him (|| הלבישׁ ). b. make firm or fixed , = definitely adopt רָע דָּבָר לָמוֺ ֿ׳יח Psa 64:6 . 5 make rigid, hard , i.e. perverse, obstinate, harden (the heart of any one) Exod 4:21 ; 10:20 , 27 (all E), 9:12 ; 11:10 ; 14:4 , 8 , 17 (all P), Josh 11:20 (D); see also ׳ח מִסֶּלַע פניהם Jer 5:3 . Nehemiah 3; compare (in General) participle used substantively בדקף מחזיקי Ezek 27:9 , 27 of Tyre and her ships (|| מַלָּחִים , etc.) 5 prevail , absolute Dan 11:7 ; followed by עַל Job 18:9 ; prevail upon to ׳הח לֶאֱכֹל בּוֺ 2Kin 4:8 . 6 especially take or keep hold of, seize, grasp: a. take hold of, seize, catch , followed by בְּ Gen 19:4 (J), 21:18 (E), Exod 4:4 (J; || אחז ), Judg 7:20 ; 1Sam 15:27 ; 2Sam 1:11 ; 1Kin 1:50 ; 2:28 ; 2Kin 2:12 ; 4:27 ; Isa 4:1 ; Zech 8:23 (twice in verse); Prov 7:13 ; 26:17 , compare also Judg 19:25 , 29 ; 2Chr 28:15 ; with violence Deut 22:25 ; 25:11 ; 1Sam 17:35 (perhaps of consecutive frequently, see Dr), 2Sam 2:16 ; 13:11 ; followed by לְ 15:5 ; figurative take hold in order to lead one (subject ׳י ) followed by בְּ Jer 31:32 , c accusative Isa 41:9 , 13 ; compare 51:18 ( בְּ ; || נֵהֵל ); followed by accusative Nahum 3:14 take hold of the brick-mould , Jer 6:23 = 50:42 , Zech 14:13 (with violence), Psa 35:2 ; Neh 4:10 ; 4:11 , seize the kingdom Dan 11:21 ; in metaphor Micah 4:9 ( חִיל הֶחֱזִיקֵךְ ), Jer 6:24 ; 8:21 ; 49:24 (see Gie), 50:43 ; of pious laying hold of ׳י , followed by בְּ Isa 64:6 ; compare 27:5 ; 56:2 , 4 , 6 ; of other gods 1Kin 9:9 2Chr 7:22 ; laying hold of wisdom Prov 3:18 , compare 4:13 ; Job 2:3 , 9 ; 27:6 ; Jer 8:5 . b. have or keep hold of , followed by בְּ Judg 16:26 ; 2Sam 3:29 ; Jer 50:33 ; Neh 4:15 . c. hold up , followed by בְּ , figurative = sustain, support Lev 25:35 ; of ׳י holding his servants Isa 42:6 ; 45:1 , compare Job 8:20 ; see also participle used substantively Dan 11:1 (|| מָעוֺז ), 11:6 (|| יֹלֵד מֵבִיא, ); of Nehemiah holding fast to his ( בְּ ) his work Neh 5:16 ; compare of wicked, holding to his house Job 8:15 ; cleave or cling to ( על ) one's brethren Neh 10:30 . hence c. keep, retain , followed by בְּ Exod 9:2 (J), Judg 7:8 ; 19:4 ; so Ezek 7:13 Sm Co ( ᵑ0 Hithpa`el); followed by anger (accusative) Micah 7:18 . d. hence also hold, contain , followed by accusative 2Chr 4:5 . Hithpa`el (especially Chronicles) Perfect הִתְחַזַּק 2Chr 13:7 3 t., etc., Imperfect וַיִּתְחַוֵּק Gen 48:2 7 t.; וַיִּתְחַזַּק 2Chr 21:4 ; 32:5 ; יִתְחַזָּ֑קוּ Ezek 7:13 (but Sm Co read Hiph`il), etc.; Imperative הִתְחַוַּק 1Kin 20:22 ; הִתְחַזְּקוּ 1Sam 4:9 ; Infinitive construct לְהִתְחַזֵּק 2Chr 13:8 ; 16:9 ; Participle מִתְחַזֵּק 2Sam 3:6 ; Dan 10:21 ; plural מִתְחַזְּקִים 1Chr 11:10 ; — 1 strengthen oneself 2Sam 3:6 ; 1Kin 20:22 ; 2Chr 1:1 ; 12:13 ; 13:21 ; 21:4 ; 23:1 ; 25:11 ; 27:6 ; followed by עַל against 17:1 ; gain strength Ezra 7:28 ; Dan 10:19 , compare ׳הִתְח ביהוה 1Sam 30:6 ; figurative= take courage 2Chr 15:8 . 2 put forth strength, use one's strength Gen 48:2 (i.e. he exerted himself, he sat up by a great effort), Num 13:20 Judg 20:22 ; 1Sam 4:9 ; 2Sam 10:12 ; 1Chr 19:13 ; 2Chr 32:5 . 3 followed by לִפְנֵי withstand 2Chr 13:7-8 ,. 4 followed by עִם hold strongly with 1Chr 11:10 ; Dan 10:21 , compare of ׳להתח אֵלָיו שָׁלֵם לְבָבָם עִם ׳י, 2Chr 16:9 . — For יִתְחַזָּ֑קו Ezek 7:13 read Hiph`il, see Sm Co Da.
